entries.name: EZ Smash
entries.description: First Thailand outpost of the Dutch smash-burger brand, burgers from B259.

entries.name: Taqueria La Nena
entries.description: Taco counter with signature sets, build-your-own options and pulled-pork fillings.

entries.name: Don Gang
entries.description: Fiery Southern Thai cooking from a Krabi 'outlaw' cook.

entries.name: Butter & Co.
entries.description: Artisanal herb, citrus and spiced butters served on warm sourdough.

entries.name: Kad Kreamery
entries.description: Pastry, ice cream and chocolate counter from the Kad Kokoa bean-to-bar team.

entries.name: Goodyguts
entries.description: Soy-protein smoothie and no-added-sugar soft-serve bar.

entries.name: 7SUNS
entries.description: Sixth Bangkok branch for the award-winning matcha specialist.

entries.name: Bubblism (by 1923)
entries.description: Tokyo-style highball bar with a striking build-out and non-alcoholic options.

entries.name: Taproom
entries.description: Craft beer with a wide IPA list, served by the tower.

entries.name: 12 Plato
entries.description: Bang Na microbrewery's new city-side taproom, plus cocktails and rice wine.

entries.name: The Clucker
entries.description: Soft-opened Jul 23; cult Clucking Donut reborn as a 20-seat Nashville hot chicken sando shop.

entries.name: ThaiCoon
entries.description: 'Real Thai. No Rules.' from chef Buddy Hatayadom and Chef Wai of Rasik; still in soft opening.

entries.name: Cuisine BKK
entries.description: Open-kitchen French from Franck Le Bayon and Morgan Daniels.

entries.name: TAANG
entries.description: 12-seat Northern Thai chef's table by Kongwuth Chaiwongkajorn at Grand Hyatt Erawan; B3,880++.

entries.name: Yamu
entries.description: Chef Mirco Keller's casual homestyle Japanese follow-up to Keller.

entries.name: Elder Burger
entries.description: Seoul Seongsu-dong craft burger brand's first Thai store, with an in-store hydroponic garden.

trend_note: Mall-scale food halls are now the main vehicle for new-brand entry - The Commons Cloud 11's Jul 20 opening delivered more new F&B doors than the rest of Bangkok combined, and is how foreign brands (EZ Smash, Bubblism) are landing.
